description:
PROBLEM TYPE: LP
PROBLEM INFO:

- A quantity y is known to depend on another quantity x. A set of corresponding values has been collected for x and y and is presented.
- The \var{k}-th y value takes \var{y_{k}} and the \var{k}-th x value takes \var{x_{k}}.

INPUT FORMAT:

{
    "y": [y_{k} for k = 1,...,K],
    "x": [x_{k} for k = 1,...,K]
}


OBJECTIVE: Fit the ‘best’ straight line y = bx + a where the objective is to minimize the maximum deviation of all the observed values of y from the value predicted by the linear relationship.

OUTPUT INFO:

- \var{intercept} represents the intercept of the fitted line
- \var{slope} represents the slope of the fitted line

OUTPUT FORMAT:

{
    "intercept": intercept,
    "slope": slope
}

objective.description: "Minimize the maximum absolute deviation between the observed y values and the values predicted by the linear function y = bx + a."

constraints.description: For each observation k, y_k - (slope * x_k + intercept) <= t
constraints.formulation: $\\forall k = 1, \\dots, NumObs, \\; Y_k - (slope \\cdot X_k + intercept) \\leq t$
constraints.code:
for k in range(NumObs):
    model.addConstr(Y[k] - (slope * X[k] + intercept) <= t)

constraints.description: For each observation k, (slope * x_k + intercept) - y_k <= t
constraints.formulation: $\\forall k = 1, \\dots, \\text{NumObs},\\; slope \\cdot X_k + intercept - Y_k \\leq t$
constraints.code:
for k in range(NumObs):
    model.addConstr(slope * X[k] + intercept - Y[k] <= t)

slope.definition: Slope of the fitted straight line

intercept.definition: Intercept of the fitted straight line

t.definition: Maximum allowed positive deviation between observed and predicted y values
